# zabbix_media_type (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Webhook media type; secrets belong in parameters (marked sensitive), not in the script.
resource "zabbix_media_type" "slack" {
  name    = "Slack"
  type    = 4
  timeout = "10s"
  script  = <<-EOT
    var params = JSON.parse(value);
    var req = new HttpRequest();
    req.addHeader('Content-Type: application/json');
    req.post(params.url, JSON.stringify({ text: params.message }));
    return 'OK';
  EOT

  parameter {
    name  = "url"
    value = var.slack_webhook_url
  }
  parameter {
    name  = "message"
    value = "{TRIGGER.NAME}: {TRIGGER.STATUS}"
  }
}

# Email media type with SMTP authentication and STARTTLS.
resource "zabbix_media_type" "email" {
  name                = "Email"
  type                = 0
  smtp_server         = "smtp.example.com"
  smtp_port           = 587
  smtp_helo           = "example.com"
  smtp_email          = "zabbix@example.com"
  smtp_security       = 1
  smtp_verify_peer    = true
  smtp_verify_host    = true
  smtp_authentication = 1
  username            = "zabbix"
  password            = var.smtp_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the media type
- `type` (Number) Media type: 0 - Email, 1 - Script, 2 - SMS, 4 - Webhook

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the media type is enabled
- `exec_path` (String) Script name (required for Script type)
- `gsm_modem` (String) GSM modem serial port (required for SMS type)
- `parameter` (Block List) List of parameters (for Webhooks) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--parameter))
- `script` (String) JavaScript code (required for Webhook type)
- `smtp_email` (String) SMTP email (required for Email type)
- `smtp_helo` (String) SMTP HELO (required for Email type)
- `smtp_server` (String) SMTP server address (required for Email type)
- `timeout` (String) Webhook execution timeout

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--parameter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameter`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the Zabbix media type ID.
terraform import zabbix_media_type.slack 42
```
